    blocked_set = set(blocked_positions)

    def can_cover(start, end, power):
        return start <= end <= start + power
    
    def find_min_cost():
        min_cost = float('inf')
        for power in range(1, k + 1):
            if lamp_costs[power - 1] == 0:
                continue
            current_cost = 0
            i = 0
            while i < n:
                if covered[i]:
                    i += 1
                    continue
                if i in blocked_set:
                    i += 1
                    continue
                j = i + 1
                while j < n and can_cover(i, j, power):
                    covered[j] = True
                    j += 1
                current_cost += lamp_costs[power - 1]
                i = j
            if all(covered):
                min_cost = min(min_cost, current_cost)
        return min_cost if min_cost != float('inf') else -1
    
    return find_min_cost()
